issues.title: Folder chevron state mismatch
issues.description: The 'exports' and 'translate' folders display collapsed chevron icons while child items are expanded.
issues.evidence: Right-pointing chevrons shown for 'exports' and 'translate' despite child rows visible underneath.
issues.suggestion: Sync chevron orientation to reflect expanded child row visibility.
issues.triageNote: Confirmed in source: expanded folders set BOTH caret spans to inline (▾ and ▸ render simultaneously, lines ~96-113), so expanded folders like 'exports' show a collapsed-looking ▸ next to visible children; made the two carets mutually exclusive.

issues.title: Detached status indicators in RTL
issues.description: Status dots remain anchored to the far left instead of aligning adjacent to tree nodes on the right.
issues.evidence: Amber, green, and black status dots appear on the far left margin while file labels indent from the right.
issues.suggestion: Mirror status indicator placement to follow row indentation in RTL.
issues.triageNote: Physical properties not mirrored in RTL, verified by pixel measurement: dots container used physical pr-2.5 (no inline-end padding in RTL, dots sit ~2px off the card's left border), selection rail used physical border-l-2 (rendered on the far-left edge x≈34-37 while the tree indents from the right), and rails used physical border-r (outer guide line buried under the card's right border); converted all to logical utilities (pe-2.5, border-s-2/border-e-0, border-e, ms-1.5).

issues.title: Active state indicator boundary collision
issues.description: The active selection bar for selected rows extends flush to the outer container border rather than respecting item padding.
issues.evidence: The solid black bar beside report-draft.md touches the card's left boundary abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Inset the active indicator bar to align with row padding.
issues.triageNote: Real: selected rows colored a 2px border-l-2 brand bar that sits exactly on the container's inner border (rows are direct children of the bordered card with no padding); replaced the flush border with an inset rounded indicator bar (absolute, inset-y/start 3px, logical start so it also mirrors in RTL) while keeping the 2px transparent border slot so row layout never shifts.

issues.title: Tree guideline icon collision
issues.description: Vertical tree guide line collides with the file icon.
issues.evidence: The left hierarchy guide line intersects the package.json file icon border.
issues.suggestion: Increase left padding on the row content to clear the guide line.
issues.triageNote: Verified by pixel measurement on the screenshot: the depth-1 guide line (x≈76-77) ends at the top of package.json's row and its column continues as the file glyph box's left border (x≈78-79) — depth-d glyph borders sit ~1px from the depth-(d+1) rail guide line; added ms-1 clearance before both glyph containers so icon boxes clear the guide-line column at every depth.
